programmes.desc: A 12-episode series that brings together cars, people, and deeper meaning! In an age of peak division, everyone still gets to choose: fuel the conflict, or fuel the unity. AUTOSAMARITANS have made their choice. Compassionate, enthusiastic car collectors, racers and local celebrities come together to share their passion with those who need it most: young people facing illness, disability, or hardship. Alongside their families, these teens get an unforgettable day: joy-rides, new friendships, inspiring encounters, and a new outlook on life. The car community unites around one goal; making sure that the most challenged youth of today has something to look forward to. Incredibly heartwarming situations unfold that we share with wide audiences around the world and across all demographics...proof that a little kindness goes a long way, and that it's contagious. We bring deeper meaning to life"
